CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_narrative_internal.scene_native_round_bound_v1(p_session uuid,p_round uuid)
RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$
DECLARE valid_source boolean;
BEGIN
 -- Provenance only: command legality, admission and current capability stay in their existing owners.
 SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds rr
  JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=rr.session_id AND cs.master_session_id=p_session
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.encounters enc ON enc.encounter_id=cs.id AND enc.master_session_id=p_session
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1 cache ON cache.master_session_id=p_session AND cache.is_active
  JOIN public.master_v2_sessions master ON master.id=p_session AND master.owner_kind='ai_service'
  JOIN public.locations loc ON loc.id=master.location_id AND loc.id=cs.location_id AND loc.is_test AND loc.is_active
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.scene_sources_v1 src ON src.scene_id=cache.id AND src.retired_at IS NULL
   AND src.technical_receipt->>'schema_version'='mission-narrative-combat-opening/1'
   AND src.technical_receipt->>'encounter_id'=cs.id::text
  JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds opening ON opening.id=(src.technical_receipt->>'opening_round_id')::uuid
   AND opening.session_id=cs.id AND opening.round_no=1
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items opening_work ON opening_work.id=src.work_id
   AND opening_work.master_session_id=p_session AND opening_work.state='completed'
   AND opening_work.message_id=src.published_message_id AND opening_work.message_id=(src.technical_receipt->>'publication_id')::uuid
  JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=opening_work.message_id AND msg.location_id=loc.id AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL
  WHERE rr.id=p_round AND rr.round_no>=opening.round_no AND NOT cs.lesiva
   AND combat_panel_private.uses_simulated_pools(cs.id) AND NOT public.combat_v2_values_written(cs.id)
   AND src.technical_receipt->>'scene_id'=cache.id::text AND src.technical_receipt->>'source_id'=src.id::text
   AND src.technical_receipt->>'actor_user_id'=src.actor_user_id::text
   AND src.technical_receipt->>'phase_key'=enc.step_key
   AND enc.request_key=(src.technical_receipt->>'request_key')::uuid
   AND public.combat_v2_sha256(enc.open_receipt)=src.technical_receipt->>'native_open_sha256'
   AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=src.technical_receipt->>'publication_sha256'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(opening.round_no,rr.round_no-1) n
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds previous
     JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports report ON report.id=previous.report_id AND report.round_id=previous.id
     JOIN public.messages published ON published.id=report.message_id AND published.location_id=loc.id
     JOIN public.combat_v2_narratives narrative ON narrative.round_id=previous.id AND narrative.report_id=report.id
      AND narrative.body=published.body AND narrative.kind='fato_ia' AND narrative.author_user IS NULL
     WHERE previous.session_id=cs.id AND previous.round_no=n AND previous.state='narrato'
      AND report.narration_state='pubblicata' AND NOT report.values_written
      AND report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(report.mechanics)
      AND published.kind='fato' AND published.recipient_user IS NULL))
 ) INTO valid_source;
 RETURN coalesce(valid_source,false);
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.role_native_combat_work_class_v4(p_work uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w mission_generic_owner.work_items;
BEGIN
 PERFORM mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF NOT (mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(w.master_session_id,false,true) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors cursor
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions staff
     ON staff.master_session_id=cursor.master_session_id
   JOIN public.master_v2_sessions master ON master.id=cursor.master_session_id
   JOIN public.locations location ON location.id=master.location_id
   WHERE cursor.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND staff.enabled
     AND master.owner_kind='ai_service' AND location.is_test
 )) OR w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;

 IF w.kind='choice' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-choice/1'
  AND mission_narrative_internal.scene_native_round_bound_v1(w.master_session_id,(w.payload->>'round_id')::uuid) THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.encounters enc ON enc.encounter_id=pc.encounter_id AND enc.master_session_id=pc.master_session_id
   JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds rr ON rr.id=(pc.legal_options#>>'{context,round_id}')::uuid AND rr.session_id=enc.encounter_id
   JOIN public.combat_v2_actors actor ON actor.id=pc.actor_id AND actor.session_id=enc.encounter_id AND actor.actor_kind='png'
   WHERE pc.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND pc.work_id=w.id AND pc.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
    AND pc.encounter_id=w.encounter_id AND pc.actor_id=(w.payload->>'actor_id')::uuid
    AND pc.request_key=(w.payload->>'command_request_key')::uuid AND pc.id=(w.payload->>'capability_id')::uuid
    AND pc.context_version=(w.payload->>'context_version')::bigint AND pc.legal_options=w.payload->'legal_options'
    AND pc.options_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pc.legal_options)
    AND pc.legal_options#>>'{context,activity_id}'=enc.encounter_id::text
    AND w.payload->>'combat_session_id'=enc.encounter_id::text AND w.payload->>'round_id'=rr.id::text
    AND w.step_key=enc.step_key AND w.run_control_version=enc.run_control_version
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(enc.actor_map) map WHERE map->>'actor_id'=pc.actor_id::text))
  THEN RETURN 'native_combat_choice';END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 IF w.kind='narration' AND w.payload->>'schema_version' IN('mission-generic-narration/1','mission-generic-narration/2')
  AND w.payload->>'mode'='combat'
  AND mission_narrative_internal.scene_native_round_bound_v1(w.master_session_id,(w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}')::uuid) THEN
  IF w.state='completed' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.message_id IS NOT NULL
   AND w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,session_id}'=w.encounter_id::text
   AND w.payload#>>'{scene,snapshot,session_id}'=w.encounter_id::text
   AND w.payload#>>'{scene,snapshot,round_id}'=w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}'
   AND w.payload#>>'{scene,snapshot_sha256}'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload#>'{scene,snapshot}')
   AND w.payload#>'{barrier,closed}'='true'::jsonb
   AND w.payload#>'{barrier,required_receipt_ids}'=jsonb_build_array(w.authority_receipt_id)
   AND w.payload#>'{barrier,receipt_ids}'=jsonb_build_array(w.authority_receipt_id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports rep JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds rr ON rr.id=rep.round_id
    JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=rr.session_id AND cs.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
    JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=rep.message_id AND msg.id=w.message_id AND msg.location_id=cs.location_id
     AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.character_id IS NULL AND msg.sender_user IS NULL AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL
    JOIN public.combat_v2_narratives narrative ON narrative.round_id=rr.id AND narrative.report_id=rep.id
     AND narrative.request_key=w.request_key AND narrative.kind='fato_ia' AND narrative.author_user IS NULL
     AND narrative.body=msg.body
    JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit ON audit.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
     AND audit.event_code='generic_finalized' AND audit.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
     AND audit.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text AND audit.details->>'message_id'=msg.id::text
     AND audit.details->>'state'='completed' AND audit.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
     AND audit.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
     AND audit.details->>'stale'='false' AND audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
     AND audit.details->'application_error_sqlstate'='null'::jsonb
    WHERE rep.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND rr.id=(w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}')::uuid
     AND rr.session_id=w.encounter_id AND rr.state='narrato' AND rep.narration_state='pubblicata'
     AND rep.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rep.mechanics) AND NOT rep.values_written
     AND rep.mechanics_sha256=w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,report_sha256}' AND msg.body=w.result->>'text')
  THEN RETURN 'native_combat_narration';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports rep JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds rr ON rr.id=rep.round_id
   WHERE rep.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND rr.id=(w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}')::uuid
    AND rr.session_id=w.encounter_id AND rr.state='risolto' AND rep.narration_state='attesa'
    AND rep.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rep.mechanics)
    AND w.payload=(mission_generic_owner.combat_narrative_source(w.master_session_id,rep.id)->'payload'))
  THEN RETURN 'native_combat_narration';END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 IF w.kind='choice' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-choice/1' THEN
   IF EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_choices panel
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.encounters encounter
       ON encounter.encounter_id=panel.encounter_id
      AND encounter.master_session_id=panel.master_session_id
     JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds round_row
       ON round_row.id=(panel.legal_options#>>'{context,round_id}')::uuid
      AND round_row.session_id=encounter.encounter_id
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows round_window
       ON round_window.round_id=round_row.id
      AND round_window.master_session_id=encounter.master_session_id
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches source_batch
       ON source_batch.id=round_window.batch_id
      AND source_batch.master_session_id=encounter.master_session_id
      AND source_batch.encounter_id=encounter.encounter_id
     WHERE panel.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND panel.work_id=w.id
       AND panel.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
       AND panel.encounter_id=w.encounter_id
       AND panel.actor_id=(w.payload->>'actor_id')::uuid
       AND panel.request_key=(w.payload->>'command_request_key')::uuid
       AND panel.id=(w.payload->>'capability_id')::uuid
       AND panel.context_version=(w.payload->>'context_version')::bigint
       AND panel.legal_options=w.payload->'legal_options'
       AND panel.options_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(panel.legal_options)
       AND panel.legal_options#>>'{context,activity_id}'=encounter.encounter_id::text
       AND w.payload->>'combat_session_id'=encounter.encounter_id::text
       AND w.payload->>'round_id'=round_row.id::text
       AND w.step_key=encounter.step_key
       AND w.run_control_version=encounter.run_control_version
       AND (
         (round_window.publication_id=source_batch.message_id
          AND source_batch.state='published')
         OR
         (round_window.publication_id IS NULL
          AND source_batch.message_id IS NULL
          AND source_batch.state='preparing'
          AND source_batch.entry_side='png'
          AND source_batch.source_window_id IS NULL
          AND source_batch.source_report_id IS NOT NULL
          AND source_batch.next_round_id=round_row.id
          AND source_batch.decision_work_id IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds prior_round
            JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports prior_report
              ON prior_report.id=source_batch.source_report_id
             AND prior_report.round_id=prior_round.id
            WHERE prior_round.id=source_batch.source_round_id
              AND prior_round.session_id=encounter.encounter_id
              AND prior_round.staff_private_successor_source
              AND prior_round.state='risolto'
          ))
       )
       AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(encounter.actor_map) actor_entry
         WHERE actor_entry->>'actor_id'=panel.actor_id::text
       )
       AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors actor_row
         WHERE actor_row.id=panel.actor_id
           AND actor_row.session_id=encounter.encounter_id
           AND actor_row.actor_kind='png'
       )
   ) THEN RETURN 'native_combat_choice'; END IF;
   RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 IF w.kind='narration' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/3'
   AND w.payload->>'mode'='unified'
   AND w.payload->'source_windows'='[]'::jsonb
 THEN
   IF EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.encounters encounter
       ON encounter.encounter_id=batch.encounter_id
      AND encounter.master_session_id=batch.master_session_id
     JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds source_round ON source_round.id=batch.source_round_id
       AND source_round.session_id=batch.encounter_id
     JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports source_report
       ON source_report.id=batch.source_report_id
      AND source_report.round_id=source_round.id
     WHERE batch.id=w.authority_receipt_id
       AND batch.writer_work_id=w.id AND (
         w.event_id=batch.id OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit reissue_audit
           JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items original_work
             ON original_work.dispatch_receipt_id=reissue_audit.receipt_id
            AND original_work.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
           CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mission_generic_owner.combat_narration_reissue_proof_v1(
             original_work.id,(reissue_audit.details->>'actor_user_id')::uuid) AS evidence) reissue
           WHERE reissue_audit.event_code='staff_combat_narration_preprovider_reissued'
             AND reissue_audit.details->>'failed_work_id'=original_work.id::text
             AND reissue_audit.details->>'successor_work_id'=w.id::text
             AND reissue.evidence->>'schema_version'='mission-combat-narration-reissue-proof/1'
             AND reissue.evidence->>'master_session_id'=w.master_session_id::text
             AND reissue.evidence->>'failed_work_id'=original_work.id::text
             AND reissue.evidence->>'successor_work_id'=w.id::text
             AND reissue.evidence->>'batch_id'=batch.id::text
             AND reissue.evidence->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256
             AND reissue.evidence->>'owned_by_me'='true'
         ) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items c24old JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches c24batch ON c24batch.id=w.authority_receipt_id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts c24receipt ON c24receipt.id=c24old.dispatch_receipt_id
 WHERE c24old.id='c88958e7-8983-4332-a14e-095076f967f4'::uuid AND w.id='48e1bdcd-f044-be8c-1923-54d38e7e822c'::uuid AND w.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
 AND w.id=md5('C889:work:'||c24old.id::text)::uuid AND w.event_id=md5('C889:event:'||c24old.id::text)::uuid AND w.request_key=md5('C889:request:'||c24old.id::text)::uuid
 AND w.dedupe_key='c889-count-reissue:'||c24old.id::text AND w.kind='narration' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/3'
 AND c24batch.id='32e674f6-f1b8-4273-973e-7da88ed2c5b9'::uuid AND c24batch.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND c24batch.writer_work_id=w.id AND c24batch.state IN('ready','published') AND c24batch.message_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.message_id
 AND c24batch.composition_kind='combat_resolved_no_pending' AND c24batch.source_window_id IS NULL AND c24batch.next_round_id IS NULL
 AND c24old.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND c24old.authority_receipt_id=c24batch.id AND c24old.state='failed'
 AND c24old.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1' AND c24old.result->>'failure_code'='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW'
 AND c24old.result->>'input_tokens'='14811' AND c24old.result->>'max_input_tokens'='12000' AND c24old.result->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
 AND c24old.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(c24old.result) AND c24old.authorization_id IS NULL AND c24old.dispatch_id IS NULL
 AND w.payload=c24old.payload AND w.payload=c24batch.payload AND w.payload_sha256=c24old.payload_sha256 AND w.payload_sha256=c24batch.payload_sha256
 AND w.payload_sha256='da8c38c23db1c04ceaaaedfb7b5ead1b43c18c1ee60b069696ba36d832c9da78'
 AND w.run_control_version=c24old.run_control_version AND w.definition_sha256=c24old.definition_sha256 AND w.revision=c24old.revision
 AND c24receipt.status='failed' AND c24receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND c24receipt.dispatch_count=0 AND c24receipt.charged_cost_usd=0
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts c24attempt WHERE c24attempt.receipt_id=c24receipt.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations c24auth WHERE c24auth.receipt_id=c24receipt.id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit c24audit WHERE c24audit.receipt_id=c24receipt.id AND c24audit.event_code='generic_count_overflow_terminal'
  AND c24audit.details->>'work_id'=c24old.id::text AND c24audit.details->>'receipt_id'=c24old.receipt_id::text AND c24audit.details->>'result_sha256'=c24old.result_sha256)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit c24audit WHERE c24audit.receipt_id=c24receipt.id AND c24audit.event_code='c889_count_narration_reissued'
  AND c24audit.details->>'old_work_id'=c24old.id::text AND c24audit.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND c24audit.details->>'batch_id'=c24batch.id::text
  AND c24audit.details->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND c24audit.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0'))) OR (
           w.dedupe_key='unified:'||batch.id||':staff-audit-requeue-1'
           AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items prior
             WHERE prior.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
               AND prior.event_id=batch.id
               AND prior.authority_receipt_id=batch.id
               AND prior.kind='narration' AND prior.state='failed'
               AND prior.payload_sha256=w.payload_sha256
               AND prior.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_PROFILE_AUDIT_INVALID"]'::jsonb
           )
         )
       )
       AND batch.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
       AND batch.source_window_id IS NULL
       AND batch.decision_work_id IS NULL AND batch.decision IS NULL
       AND (
         (batch.composition_kind IN (
           'combat_defense_resolved','combat_exit','combat_resolved_no_pending')
          AND batch.next_round_id IS NULL)
         OR
         (batch.composition_kind='combat_resolved_then_png_offensive'
          AND batch.entry_side='png' AND batch.next_round_id IS NOT NULL
          AND batch.secondary_report_id IS NULL AND batch.retired_at IS NULL
          AND source_round.report_id=source_report.id
          AND source_report.values_written IS FALSE
          AND source_report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(source_report.mechanics)
          AND EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds pending_round
            JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows pending_window
              ON pending_window.round_id=pending_round.id
             AND pending_window.batch_id=batch.id
             AND pending_window.master_session_id=batch.master_session_id
             AND pending_window.side='png'
            JOIN public.master_v2_sessions pending_master ON pending_master.id=batch.master_session_id
            JOIN public.locations pending_location ON pending_location.id=pending_master.location_id
              AND pending_location.is_test AND pending_location.is_active
            JOIN public.mission_run_state pending_run ON pending_run.master_session_id=batch.master_session_id
            JOIN mission_generic_owner.run_bindings pending_binding ON pending_binding.master_session_id=batch.master_session_id
            WHERE pending_round.id=batch.next_round_id
              AND pending_round.session_id=batch.encounter_id
              AND pending_round.round_no=source_round.round_no+1
              AND pending_master.owner_kind='ai_service' AND pending_master.closed_at IS NULL
              AND pending_run.current_step_key=w.step_key
              AND pending_run.control_version=w.run_control_version
              AND pending_binding.snapshot_sha256=w.definition_sha256
              AND pending_binding.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(pending_binding.snapshot)
              AND cardinality(pending_window.expected_actor_ids)>0
              AND jsonb_typeof(w.payload->'pending_offensives')='array'
              AND jsonb_array_length(w.payload->'pending_offensives')=cardinality(pending_window.expected_actor_ids)
              AND NOT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM unnest(pending_window.expected_actor_ids) expected_actor
                WHERE NOT EXISTS(
                  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.payload->'pending_offensives') pending
                  JOIN public.combat_v2_declarations declaration
                    ON declaration.id::text=pending->>'declaration_id'
                   AND declaration.id::text=pending->>'receipt_id'
                   AND declaration.round_id=pending_round.id
                   AND declaration.actor_id=expected_actor
                  JOIN public.combat_v2_actors pending_actor
                    ON pending_actor.id=declaration.actor_id AND pending_actor.session_id=batch.encounter_id
                   AND pending_actor.actor_kind='png'
                  JOIN combat_panel_private.actor_turns pending_turn
                    ON pending_turn.round_id=declaration.round_id AND pending_turn.actor_id=declaration.actor_id
                   AND pending_turn.main_declaration_id=declaration.id
                  JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pending_choice
                    ON pending_choice.actor_id=declaration.actor_id
                   AND pending_choice.request_key=declaration.request_key
                   AND pending_choice.master_session_id=batch.master_session_id
                   AND pending_choice.encounter_id=batch.encounter_id
                   AND pending_choice.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
                  JOIN combat_panel_private.request_receipts pending_receipt
                    ON pending_receipt.principal_user=pending_choice.principal_id
                   AND pending_receipt.request_key=pending_choice.request_key
                   AND pending_receipt.viewer_envelope=pending_choice.result
                   AND pending_receipt.viewer_envelope#>>'{receipt,declaration_id}'=declaration.id::text
                  WHERE pending->>'round_id'=pending_round.id::text
                    AND pending->>'actor_id'=expected_actor::text
                )
              )
              AND (
                (batch.state='ready' AND batch.message_id IS NULL AND w.message_id IS NULL
                 AND batch.published_at IS NULL AND pending_window.publication_id IS NULL
                 AND source_round.staff_private_successor_source AND source_round.state='risolto'
                 AND source_report.narration_state='attesa' AND source_report.message_id IS NULL
                 AND pending_round.state='raccolta_difese' AND pending_round.phase='raccolta_difese'
                 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_attack_targets pending_target
                   WHERE pending_target.round_id=pending_round.id)
                 AND w.payload->'pending_offensives'=mission_generic_owner.unified_pending(pending_round.id))
                OR
                (batch.state='published' AND batch.published_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND batch.message_id IS NOT NULL AND pending_window.publication_id=batch.message_id
                 AND source_round.state='narrato' AND source_report.narration_state='pubblicata'
                 AND source_report.message_id=batch.message_id
                 AND (w.message_id IS NULL OR w.message_id=batch.message_id)
                 AND EXISTS(
                   SELECT 1 FROM public.messages publication_message
                   JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_report_publications publication
                     ON publication.report_id=source_report.id AND publication.round_id=source_round.id
                    AND publication.batch_id=batch.id AND publication.primary_report
                    AND publication.message_id=publication_message.id
                   JOIN public.combat_v2_narratives publication_narrative
                     ON publication_narrative.report_id=source_report.id
                    AND publication_narrative.round_id=source_round.id
                    AND publication_narrative.request_key=w.request_key
                    AND publication_narrative.kind='fato_ia' AND publication_narrative.author_user IS NULL
                    AND publication_narrative.body=publication_message.body
                   WHERE publication_message.id=batch.message_id
                     AND publication_message.location_id=pending_master.location_id
                     AND publication_message.kind='fato' AND publication_message.recipient_user IS NULL
                 ))
              )
          ))
       )
       AND w.encounter_id=batch.encounter_id
       AND w.step_key=batch.step_key AND w.step_key=encounter.step_key
       AND w.run_control_version=batch.run_control_version
       AND w.run_control_version=encounter.run_control_version
       AND w.payload=batch.payload AND w.payload_sha256=batch.payload_sha256
       AND w.payload->>'batch_id'=batch.id::text
       AND w.payload->>'composition_kind'=batch.composition_kind
       AND (batch.secondary_report_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports secondary_report
         JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds secondary_round
           ON secondary_round.id=secondary_report.round_id
         WHERE secondary_report.id=batch.secondary_report_id
           AND secondary_round.session_id=batch.encounter_id
       ))
   ) THEN RETURN 'native_combat_narration'; END IF;
   RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_roleless_receipt(p_declaration uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare dd public.combat_v2_declarations; rr record;
begin
 select * into strict dd from public.combat_v2_declarations where id=p_declaration;
 if dd.kind<>'passa' or coalesce(btrim(dd.declaration_text),'')<>''
  or not (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows ur where ur.round_id=dd.round_id)
    OR mission_narrative_internal.scene_native_round_bound_v1((SELECT master_session_id FROM public.combat_v2_sessions s JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds r ON r.session_id=s.id WHERE r.id=dd.round_id),dd.round_id))
 then raise exception 'MUF_ROLELESS_NOT_ADMITTED';end if;
 select cr.event_id,cr.command_fingerprint,oo.id offer_id into strict rr
 from combat_panel_private.request_receipts cr join combat_panel_private.offers oo on oo.id=cr.offer_id
 join public.combat_v2_actors aa on aa.id=dd.actor_id
 where cr.request_key=dd.request_key and oo.actor_id=dd.actor_id and oo.principal_user=cr.principal_user
 and oo.state='consumed' and oo.consumed_request_key=dd.request_key and oo.requires_role=false
 and oo.source_payload->>'kind'='passa' and cr.event_id is not null
 and cr.viewer_envelope#>>'{receipt,declaration_id}'=dd.id::text
 and ((aa.actor_kind='pg' and aa.controller_user=cr.principal_user)
 or (aa.actor_kind='png' and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc
 where pc.actor_id=dd.actor_id and pc.principal_id=cr.principal_user and pc.request_key=dd.request_key
 and pc.consumed_at is not null and pc.result=cr.viewer_envelope and pc.command_sha256=cr.command_fingerprint)));
 return jsonb_build_object('declaration_id',dd.id,'actor_id',dd.actor_id,'kind','passa','role_required',false,
 'receipt_id',rr.event_id,'source_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(jsonb_build_object('declaration',to_jsonb(dd),
 'event_id',rr.event_id,'offer_id',rr.offer_id,'command_fingerprint',rr.command_fingerprint)));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.regia_round_publication_state_v1(p_master_session uuid, p_actor uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE m public.master_v2_sessions%ROWTYPE;
 s public.combat_v2_sessions%ROWTYPE;
 r public.combat_v2_rounds%ROWTYPE;
 w mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows%ROWTYPE;
 pw mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows%ROWTYPE;
 b mission_generic_owner.unified_batches%ROWTYPE;
 hw mission_generic_owner.regia_human_windows_v1%ROWTYPE;
 report public.combat_v2_round_reports%ROWTYPE;
 is_master boolean; can_main boolean:=false; can_defend boolean:=false;
 slots jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
 private_hw boolean:=false;
 scene56_receipt jsonb;scene56_round public.combat_v2_rounds;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO m FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=p_master_session;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exam_human_private.requests e
   WHERE e.master_session_id=m.id AND e.state='combat')
 THEN RETURN exam_human_private.round_publication_state_v1(m.id,p_actor); END IF;
 IF m.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l
    WHERE l.id=m.location_id AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
      AND l.is_active AND l.is_test)
   AND NOT mission_public_owner.role_session_allowed_v1(m.id)
   AND NOT mission_public_owner.human_session_allowed_v1(m.id)
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
    'status','unavailable','reason_code','not_opted_in','public',null,'master',null); END IF;
 is_master:=coalesce(m.master_user=auth.uid() AND public.master_v2_is_master(auth.uid()),false);
 IF NOT is_master
   AND mission_generic_owner.principal_in_session(m.id,auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants p
      JOIN public.characters c ON c.id=p.character_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id_snapshot
      WHERE p.session_id=m.id AND p.user_id_snapshot=auth.uid()
        AND p.left_at IS NULL AND p.engagement_state='attivo')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_actor IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
   JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=a.session_id
   WHERE a.id=p_actor AND cs.master_session_id=m.id
     AND a.controller_user=auth.uid())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.combat_v2_sessions
   WHERE master_session_id=m.id AND state NOT IN('chiuso','annullato')
   ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF s.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
   'status',CASE WHEN is_master THEN 'ready' ELSE 'unavailable' END,
   'activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
   'reason_code','REGIA_ENTRY_STAGING_REQUIRED',
   'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1',
     'window_id',null,'public_round_id',null,'publication_id',null,
     'publication_revision',m.control_version,'context_version',m.control_version,
     'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',false,'defense',false,'reaction',false),
     'reason_code','regia_fato_pending'),
   'master',CASE WHEN is_master THEN jsonb_build_object(
     'schema_version','regia-round-preparation/1','window_id',null,
     'source_round_id',null,'source_report_id',null,'source_report_sha256',null,
     'next_round_id',null,'preparation_revision',m.control_version,
     'control_version',m.control_version,'side',null,'legal_png_slots','[]'::jsonb,
     'state','entry_staging_required','can_prepare',false,'can_publish',false,
     'direction_context',mission_generic_owner.regia_human_direction_context_v1(m.id))
     ELSE NULL END); END IF;
 IF NOT (SELECT l.is_test FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=m.location_id)
  AND NOT ((m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND mission_public_owner.ai_resource_scope_v1(m.id,s.id))
    OR (m.owner_kind='human' AND mission_public_owner.human_resource_scope_v1(m.id,s.id,false)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_RESOURCE_POLICY_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1 cache WHERE cache.master_session_id=m.id AND cache.is_active)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1 cache WHERE cache.master_session_id=m.id AND cache.is_active AND cache.mode='combat')
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds rr ON rr.id=uw.round_id WHERE rr.session_id=s.id) THEN
  SELECT * INTO scene56_round FROM public.combat_v2_rounds rr WHERE rr.session_id=s.id ORDER BY rr.round_no DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF scene56_round.round_no=1 THEN
   scene56_receipt:=mission_narrative_internal.scene_opening_receipt_v1(scene56_round.id);
  ELSIF mission_narrative_internal.scene_native_round_bound_v1(m.id,scene56_round.id) THEN
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('publication_id',cache.last_publication_id,'state_version_after',cache.state_version) INTO scene56_receipt
   FROM mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1 cache
   JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds previous ON previous.session_id=s.id AND previous.round_no=scene56_round.round_no-1
   JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports previous_report ON previous_report.id=previous.report_id AND previous_report.round_id=previous.id
    AND previous_report.message_id=cache.last_publication_id AND previous_report.narration_state='pubblicata'
   JOIN public.messages published ON published.id=cache.last_publication_id AND published.location_id=m.location_id
   WHERE cache.master_session_id=m.id AND cache.is_active AND cache.mode='combat'
    AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(published.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=cache.last_publication_sha256;
  END IF;
  IF scene56_receipt IS NOT NULL THEN
   can_main:=p_actor IS NOT NULL AND scene56_round.phase='raccolta_azioni' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
    WHERE a.id=p_actor AND a.session_id=s.id AND a.actor_kind='pg' AND a.state='attivo' AND a.controller_user=auth.uid()
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations d WHERE d.round_id=scene56_round.id AND d.actor_id=a.id AND d.kind IN('attacco','movimento','utilita','passa')));
   can_defend:=p_actor IS NOT NULL AND scene56_round.phase='raccolta_difese' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_attack_targets t WHERE t.round_id=scene56_round.id AND t.target_actor_id=p_actor AND t.state='attesa_difesa') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations d WHERE d.round_id=scene56_round.id AND d.actor_id=p_actor AND d.kind IN('difesa','nessuna'));
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1 cache WHERE cache.master_session_id=m.id AND cache.turn_owner='combat') THEN can_main:=false;can_defend:=false;END IF;
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1','status','ready','activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
    'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1','window_id',scene56_round.id,'public_round_id',scene56_round.id,
    'publication_id',scene56_receipt->'publication_id','publication_revision',(scene56_receipt->>'state_version_after')::bigint,
    'context_version',m.control_version,'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',can_main,'defense',can_defend,'reaction',can_defend),
    'reason_code',null),'master',null);
  END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO hw FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_windows_v1 h
  WHERE h.encounter_id=s.id AND h.side='terminal' AND h.state='private'
  ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF hw.id IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO report FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports WHERE id=hw.source_report_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
    'status','ready','activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
    'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1',
      'window_id',null,'public_round_id',null,'publication_id',null,
      'publication_revision',m.control_version,'context_version',m.control_version,
      'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',false,'defense',false,'reaction',false),
      'reason_code','regia_fato_pending'),
    'master',CASE WHEN NOT is_master THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
      'schema_version','regia-round-preparation/1',
      'window_id',hw.id,'source_round_id',hw.source_round_id,
      'source_report_id',hw.source_report_id,
      'source_report_sha256',hw.source_report_sha256,'next_round_id',null,
      'preparation_revision',hw.preparation_revision,
      'control_version',m.control_version,'side','terminal',
      'legal_png_slots','[]'::jsonb,'state','terminal',
      'can_prepare',false,'can_publish',true,
      'direction_context',mission_generic_owner.regia_human_direction_context_v1(m.id)) END);
 END IF;
 -- C1244 AGG5: prima apertura Native privata attestata anche ai PG.
 -- Nessuna proiezione Master viene consegnata; il ramo Master admitted resta invariato.
 IF m.owner_kind='human' AND m.closed_at IS NULL
   AND m.stato IN ('in_corso','sospesa')
   AND m.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations loc
     WHERE loc.id=m.location_id AND loc.is_active AND loc.is_test)
   AND (NOT is_master OR NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_admissions_v1 adm
      WHERE adm.master_session_id=m.id AND adm.encounter_id=s.id))
   AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_session_optins_v1 opt
      WHERE opt.master_session_id=m.id AND opt.actor_user=m.master_user)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_admissions_v1 adm
      WHERE adm.master_session_id=m.id AND adm.encounter_id=s.id))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw
     JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds ur ON ur.id=uw.round_id
     WHERE uw.master_session_id=m.id AND ur.session_id=s.id)
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
   'status','ready','activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
   'reason_code','REGIA_OPENING_STAGED',
   'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1',
     'window_id',null,'public_round_id',null,'publication_id',null,
     'publication_revision',m.control_version,'context_version',m.control_version,
     'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',false,'defense',false,'reaction',false),
     'reason_code','regia_fato_pending'),
   'master',null); END IF;
 IF is_master AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_admissions_v1 h
      WHERE h.encounter_id=s.id AND h.master_session_id=m.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw
      WHERE uw.master_session_id=m.id AND uw.round_id IN
       (SELECT id FROM public.combat_v2_rounds WHERE session_id=s.id))
 THEN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.combat_v2_rounds WHERE session_id=s.id
    ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF r.state<>'risolto' THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
     'status','ready','activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
     'reason_code','REGIA_OPENING_STAGED',
     'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1',
       'window_id',null,'public_round_id',null,'publication_id',null,
       'publication_revision',m.control_version,'context_version',m.control_version,
       'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',false,'defense',false,'reaction',false),
       'reason_code','regia_fato_pending'),
     'master',jsonb_build_object(
       'schema_version','regia-round-preparation/1','window_id',null,
       'source_round_id',null,'source_report_id',null,'source_report_sha256',null,
       'next_round_id',r.id,'preparation_revision',m.control_version,
       'control_version',m.control_version,'side',null,'legal_png_slots','[]'::jsonb,
       'state','entry_staged',
       'can_prepare',coalesce((mission_generic_owner.regia_human_direction_context_v1(m.id)->>'can_direct')::boolean,false),
       'can_publish',false,
       'direction_context',mission_generic_owner.regia_human_direction_context_v1(m.id)));
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO report FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports WHERE round_id=r.id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
   'status','ready','activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
   'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1',
     'window_id',r.id,'public_round_id',r.id,'publication_id',report.message_id,
     'publication_revision',m.control_version,'context_version',m.control_version,
     'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',false,'defense',false,'reaction',false),
     'reason_code',null),
   'master',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-preparation/1',
     'window_id',null,'source_round_id',r.id,'source_report_id',report.id,
     'source_report_sha256',report.mechanics_sha256,'next_round_id',null,
     'preparation_revision',m.control_version,'control_version',m.control_version,
     'side',null,'legal_png_slots','[]'::jsonb,'state','resolved',
     'can_prepare',r.state='risolto' AND report.narration_state='attesa',
     'can_publish',false,
     'direction_context',mission_generic_owner.regia_human_direction_context_v1(m.id)));
 END IF;
 SELECT x.* INTO r FROM public.combat_v2_rounds x
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw ON uw.round_id=x.id
   WHERE x.session_id=s.id AND uw.master_session_id=m.id
   ORDER BY x.round_no DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF r.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
   'status','unavailable','reason_code','not_opted_in','public',null,'master',null); END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows WHERE round_id=r.id;
 SELECT * INTO b FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches WHERE id=w.batch_id;
 SELECT * INTO hw FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_windows_v1
   WHERE next_round_id=w.round_id AND batch_id=b.id;
 -- C1244 AGG6: la finestra privata conserva il referto precedente e la propria revisione.
 private_hw:=hw.id IS NOT NULL AND hw.state='private'
   AND m.owner_kind='human'
   AND m.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND w.publication_id IS NULL;
 SELECT q.* INTO report FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports q
  WHERE (private_hw AND q.id=hw.source_report_id)
     OR (NOT private_hw AND ((r.state='risolto' AND q.round_id=r.id)
       OR (r.state<>'risolto' AND q.id=b.source_report_id)))
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.round_id=r.id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1;
 SELECT uw.* INTO pw FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw
   JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds rr ON rr.id=uw.round_id
   WHERE rr.session_id=s.id AND uw.publication_id IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY rr.round_no DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF p_actor IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
   WHERE a.id=p_actor AND a.session_id=s.id AND a.controller_user=auth.uid())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF w.publication_id IS NOT NULL AND p_actor IS NOT NULL THEN
   can_main:=r.phase='raccolta_azioni' AND p_actor=ANY(w.expected_actor_ids)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations d
       WHERE d.round_id=r.id AND d.actor_id=p_actor AND d.kind IN('attacco','movimento','utilita','passa'));
   can_defend:=r.phase='raccolta_difese' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_attack_targets t
       WHERE t.round_id=r.id AND t.target_actor_id=p_actor AND t.state='attesa_difesa')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations d
       WHERE d.round_id=r.id AND d.actor_id=p_actor AND d.kind IN('difesa','nessuna'));
 END IF;
 IF is_master THEN
   SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_id',a.id,
      'action_due',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations d
         WHERE d.round_id=r.id AND d.actor_id=a.id AND d.kind IN('attacco','movimento','utilita','passa')))
      ORDER BY a.initiative_snapshot DESC,a.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO slots
   FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
   WHERE a.id=ANY(w.expected_actor_ids) AND a.session_id=s.id
     AND a.actor_kind='png' AND a.state='attivo';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-publication-state/1',
   'status','ready','activity_id',m.id,'actor_id',p_actor,
   'public',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','regia-round-public/1',
      'window_id',pw.round_id,'public_round_id',pw.round_id,
      'publication_id',pw.publication_id,
      'publication_revision',coalesce(b.run_control_version,m.control_version),
      'context_version',m.control_version,
      'permissions',jsonb_build_object('main',can_main,'defense',can_defend,'reaction',can_defend),
      'reason_code',CASE WHEN w.publication_id IS NULL THEN 'regia_fato_pending' ELSE NULL END),
   'master',CASE WHEN NOT is_master THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
      'schema_version','regia-round-preparation/1',
      'window_id',coalesce(hw.id,w.round_id),
      'source_round_id',CASE WHEN private_hw THEN hw.source_round_id
         WHEN r.state='risolto' THEN r.id ELSE b.source_round_id END,
      'source_report_id',CASE WHEN private_hw THEN hw.source_report_id
         WHEN r.state='risolto' THEN
         (SELECT id FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports WHERE round_id=r.id)
         ELSE b.source_report_id END,
      'source_report_sha256',CASE WHEN private_hw THEN hw.source_report_sha256
         ELSE report.mechanics_sha256 END,'next_round_id',w.round_id,
      'preparation_revision',CASE WHEN private_hw THEN hw.preparation_revision
         WHEN r.state='risolto'
         THEN m.control_version ELSE coalesce(hw.preparation_revision,m.control_version) END,
      'control_version',m.control_version,
      'side',w.side,'legal_png_slots',slots,
      'state',CASE WHEN w.publication_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'published' ELSE 'private' END,
      'can_prepare',hw.id IS NOT NULL AND w.publication_id IS NOT NULL
        AND r.state='risolto' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports qr
          WHERE qr.round_id=r.id AND qr.narration_state='attesa'),
      'direction_context',mission_generic_owner.regia_human_direction_context_v1(m.id),
      'can_publish',hw.id IS NOT NULL AND hw.state='private'
       AND (hw.side='pg' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(w.expected_actor_ids) actor(id)
         WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.actor_turns turn_row
          WHERE turn_row.round_id=r.id AND turn_row.actor_id=actor.id
            AND turn_row.main_declaration_id IS NOT NULL)))) END);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_combat_writer_reissue_proof_v1(p_work uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w mission_generic_owner.work_items;su mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 m public.master_v2_sessions;rep public.combat_v2_round_reports;dr mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;
 wc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;au mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit;
 root mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1;wake mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1;
 who uuid;sid uuid;ev uuid;rq uuid;req jsonb;published boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF p_work IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR(auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid()<>p_user) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF NOT FOUND OR w.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'narration' OR w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
  OR w.payload->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-narration/2' OR w.payload->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'combat'
  OR w.message_id IS NOT NULL OR w.finalized_at IS NULL OR w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL
  OR w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
  OR w.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
  OR w.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  OR w.result->>'failure_code' IS DISTINCT FROM 'request_validation_failed'
  OR w.result->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text OR w.result->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id::text
  OR w.result->>'event_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.event_id::text OR w.result->>'request_key' IS DISTINCT FROM w.request_key::text
  OR w.result->>'provider_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '0' OR (w.result->>'charged_cost_usd')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO m FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=w.master_session_id;
 IF m.owner_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'ai_service' OR m.master_user IS NOT NULL
  OR m.location_id IS DISTINCT FROM '0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=m.location_id AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles pr JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.user_id_snapshot=pr.id
    JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
    WHERE pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master') AND mp.session_id=m.id)
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(m.id) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO wc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=w.id;
 IF wc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract)
  OR wc.contract->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-narrative-admission/3'
  OR wc.contract->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
  OR wc.contract->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text OR wc.contract->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256
  OR wc.contract->>'payload_schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-narration/2'
  OR wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,schema_version}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-work-execution-attestation/3'
  OR wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,execution_context}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
  OR NOT(wc.contract->'features'?'execution_authority_v1') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO dr FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=w.dispatch_receipt_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR dr.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.id OR dr.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.id
  OR dr.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM w.request_key OR dr.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed' OR dr.dispatch_count IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  OR dr.finalized_at IS NULL OR dr.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR dr.upper_bound_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  OR dr.envelope_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(dr.envelope) OR dr.authority_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM dr.envelope_sha256
  OR dr.envelope->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text OR dr.envelope->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts x WHERE x.receipt_id=dr.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations x WHERE x.receipt_id=dr.id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls x WHERE x.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND x.source_id=dr.id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id
   AND a.event_code='generic_pre_provider_failed' AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
   AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
   AND a.details->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed' AND a.details->>'provider_calls'='0'
   AND (a.details->>'charged_cost_usd')::numeric=0) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT (a.details->>'actor_user_id')::uuid INTO who FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
  WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id AND a.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1' AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
   AND a.details->>'envelope_sha256'=dr.envelope_sha256;
 SELECT * INTO root FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 WHERE master_session_id=m.id AND event_domain='start' AND event_version=1;
 IF who IS NULL OR who IS DISTINCT FROM root.root_principal THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rep FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports WHERE id=w.authority_receipt_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR rep.mechanics_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rep.mechanics) OR rep.values_written IS DISTINCT FROM false
  OR rep.mechanics_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,report_sha256}'
  OR rep.round_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions s ON s.id=r.session_id
   WHERE r.id=rep.round_id AND s.id=w.encounter_id AND s.master_session_id=m.id AND s.location_id=m.location_id
    AND NOT public.combat_v2_values_written(s.id)) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 sid:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(w.id,'native-combat-writer-reissue/1:work');
 ev:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(w.id,'native-combat-writer-reissue/1:event');
 rq:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(w.id,'native-combat-writer-reissue/1:request');
 SELECT * INTO su FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=sid;
 SELECT * INTO au FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id AND a.event_code='native_combat_writer_preprovider_reissued_v1';
 IF su.id IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF su.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id OR su.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'narration'
   OR su.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM rep.id OR su.encounter_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.encounter_id
   OR su.event_id IS DISTINCT FROM ev OR su.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM rq
   OR su.payload IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload OR su.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256
   OR su.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM w.step_key OR su.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM w.run_control_version
   OR su.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM w.definition_sha256 OR au.id IS NULL
   OR au.details->>'failed_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text OR au.details->>'old_result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.result_sha256
   OR au.details->>'successor_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM su.id::text OR au.details->>'actor_user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM who::text
   OR au.details->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256 OR au.details->>'report_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rep.mechanics_sha256
   OR au.details->>'report_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rep.id::text OR au.details->>'provider_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'
  THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  req:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',su.event_id,'request_key',su.request_key,'expected_revision',su.revision);
  SELECT * INTO wake FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 WHERE event_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(su.id,'server-event:writer-ready') AND event_version=1;
  IF wake.work_id IS DISTINCT FROM su.id OR wake.canonical_request IS DISTINCT FROM req OR wake.root_principal IS DISTINCT FROM who
   OR wake.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM su.id OR wake.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM su.payload_sha256
   OR wake.root_event_key IS DISTINCT FROM root.root_event_key THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  published:=su.state='completed' AND su.message_id=rep.message_id AND rep.narration_state='pubblicata'
   AND su.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND su.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds rr
    JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=rep.message_id AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.location_id=m.location_id
     AND msg.character_id IS NULL AND msg.sender_user IS NULL AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL
    JOIN public.combat_v2_narratives n ON n.round_id=rr.id AND n.report_id=rep.id AND n.request_key=su.request_key
     AND n.kind='fato_ia' AND n.author_user IS NULL AND n.body=msg.body
    JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit da ON da.receipt_id=su.dispatch_receipt_id
     AND da.event_code='generic_finalized' AND da.details->>'work_id'=su.id::text
     AND da.details->>'receipt_id'=su.receipt_id::text AND da.details->>'state'='completed'
     AND da.details->>'result_sha256'=su.result_sha256 AND da.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(su.result)
     AND da.details->>'message_id'=msg.id::text AND da.details->>'stale'='false'
     AND da.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND da.details->'application_error_sqlstate'='null'::jsonb
    WHERE rr.id=rep.round_id AND rr.session_id=w.encounter_id AND rr.state='narrato' AND msg.body=su.result->>'text');
 ELSE
  IF au.id IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT published THEN
  IF m.closed_at IS NOT NULL OR m.suspended_at IS NOT NULL OR rep.narration_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'attesa' OR rep.message_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants mp WHERE mp.session_id=m.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
     AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.mission_run_state rs JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds rr ON rr.id=rep.round_id AND rr.state='risolto'
    WHERE rs.master_session_id=m.id AND rs.run_phase='in_corso' AND rs.current_step_key=w.step_key AND rs.control_version=w.run_control_version)
   OR NOT mission_narrative_internal.scene_native_round_bound_v1(m.id,rep.round_id)
   OR w.payload#>>'{scene_binding,session_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM w.encounter_id::text
   OR w.payload#>>'{scene,snapshot_sha256}' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload#>'{scene,snapshot}')
   OR w.payload#>'{barrier,closed}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR w.payload#>'{barrier,required_receipt_ids}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(rep.id)
   OR w.payload#>'{barrier,receipt_ids}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(rep.id)
  THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-native-combat-writer-reissue-proof/1',
  'master_session_id',m.id,'failed_work_id',w.id,'authority_receipt_id',rep.id,'report_id',rep.id,
  'report_sha256',rep.mechanics_sha256,'payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,'owned_by_me',who=p_user,
  'can_reissue',who=p_user AND su.id IS NULL,'successor_work_id',su.id,'successor_request',req,
  'successor_publication_id',CASE WHEN published THEN su.message_id ELSE NULL END,
  'can_resume',who=p_user AND su.id IS NOT NULL AND su.state='ready' AND su.finalized_at IS NULL,
  'actor_user_id',who,'audit_sha256',CASE WHEN au.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.combat_v2_sha256(au.details) END,'published',published);
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare scene56 mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1;surface56 jsonb;public56 jsonb;event56 jsonb;caps56 jsonb;
 uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;combat_recovery jsonb;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 mb_read_recovery boolean:=false;mb_mode boolean:=false; st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 retained_handoff jsonb:=NULL;retained_row record;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
  nw_original_sha text;nw_original_key uuid;nw_mode boolean:=false;
 budget1_effective numeric;budget1_policy numeric;
 role_command_capability jsonb:=NULL;role_command_enabled boolean:=false;event42_mode boolean:=false;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 SELECT * INTO scene56 FROM mission_narrative_internal.scene_runtime_v1 WHERE master_session_id=m.id AND is_active;
 IF FOUND THEN
  public56:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-narrative-scene-public/1','scene_id',scene56.id,
   'state_version',scene56.state_version,'mode',scene56.mode,'last_publication_id',scene56.last_publication_id);
  surface56:=mission_narrative_internal.scene_entry_surface_v1(m.id,uid);
  IF scene56.mode<>'combat' THEN
   SELECT proof.x INTO combat_recovery FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items cw
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT mission_generic_owner.native_combat_writer_reissue_proof_v1(cw.id,uid) x) proof
    WHERE cw.master_session_id=m.id AND cw.kind='narration' AND cw.state='failed' AND proof.x IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cw.created_at DESC,cw.id DESC LIMIT 1;
   IF combat_recovery IS NOT NULL THEN combat_recovery:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-combat-narration-recovery/2','master_session_id',m.id,'failed_work_id',combat_recovery->'failed_work_id','authority_receipt_id',combat_recovery->'authority_receipt_id','report_id',combat_recovery->'report_id','payload_sha256',combat_recovery->'payload_sha256','owned_by_me',combat_recovery->'owned_by_me','can_reissue',combat_recovery->'can_reissue','successor_work_id',combat_recovery->'successor_work_id','successor_request',combat_recovery->'successor_request','can_resume',false,'successor_publication_id',combat_recovery->'successor_publication_id');END IF;
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-role-submit-capability/2',
    'enabled',scene56.mode='narrative' AND scene56.turn_owner='players',
    'contexts',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('character_id',p.character_id,'window_epoch',cur.window_epoch,
     'own_latest_message_id',(SELECT rs.message_id FROM mission_generic_owner.role_submissions rs
      WHERE rs.master_session_id=m.id AND rs.window_epoch=cur.window_epoch AND rs.user_id=uid
       AND rs.character_id=p.character_id ORDER BY rs.accepted_at DESC,rs.message_id DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY p.character_id),'[]'::jsonb))
   INTO caps56 FROM public.master_v2_participants p JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=p.character_id AND ch.user_id=uid
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors cur ON cur.master_session_id=p.session_id
   WHERE p.session_id=m.id AND p.user_id_snapshot=uid AND p.left_at IS NULL AND p.engagement_state='attivo';
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('event_key',es.event_key,'event_version',es.event_version,'state',es.state,
    'can_recover',es.root_principal=uid AND scene56.mode<>'closed'
     AND (es.state<>'running' OR es.claim_expires_at<=clock_timestamp())
     AND (es.work_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items ew
      WHERE ew.id=es.work_id AND ew.state='ready' AND ew.lease_id IS NULL))) INTO event56
   FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 es WHERE es.master_session_id=m.id
   ORDER BY es.created_at DESC,es.event_key DESC,es.event_version DESC LIMIT 1;
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('session_id',m.id,'step_key',scene56.current_phase_key,
    'objective',(SELECT x->>'objective' FROM jsonb_array_elements(scene56.snapshot->'phases')x WHERE x->>'phase_key'=scene56.current_phase_key),
    'narrative_scene',public56,'role_submit_capability',caps56,'server_event_mode','server_event_v1',
    'server_event_status',event56,'combat_surface',surface56,'staff_finish',mission_generic_owner.staff_finish_status_v1(m.id,uid))
    ||CASE WHEN combat_recovery IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('combat_narration_recovery',combat_recovery) END;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.retired_at IS NULL AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 event42_mode:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 mode42 WHERE mode42.master_session_id=m.id AND mode42.event_domain='start');
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 WITH room_session_source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source.id,room_source.work_id
  FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows room_source
  WHERE room_source.master_session_id=m.id
 ), room_released_sources AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source_row.id,room_source_row.work_id
  FROM room_session_source_rows room_source_row
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(room_source_row.id)
 )
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from room_released_sources superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
   'finalized_at',uf_work.finalized_at,'message_id',uf_work.message_id,
   'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
    'master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
    'expected_revision',uf_work.revision));
 end if;
 -- Freeze only identities/states needed to wake progress, never the clock. Include
 -- declarations because a completed defense may advance mechanics without a run transition.
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('encounter_id',uf_enc.id,'state',uf_enc.state,
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('round_id',uf_r.id,'phase',uf_r.phase,
    'state',uf_r.state,'report_id',uf_r.report_id,'narrated_at',uf_r.narrated_at,
    'declarations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(uf_d.id,uf_d.state) order by uf_d.id)
       from public.combat_v2_declarations uf_d where uf_d.round_id=uf_r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_r.round_no)
   from (select uf_round.* from public.combat_v2_rounds uf_round where uf_round.session_id=uf_enc.id
     order by uf_round.round_no desc limit 2) uf_r),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_enc.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into uf_rounds from public.combat_v2_sessions uf_enc
 where uf_enc.master_session_id=m.id and uf_enc.closed_at is null
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches hidden_batch
   where hidden_batch.encounter_id=uf_enc.id and hidden_batch.source_window_id is not null
     and hidden_batch.composition_kind='entry_png' AND hidden_batch.retired_at IS NULL and hidden_batch.state in('preparing','ready')
     and hidden_batch.message_id is null);
 uf_marker:=mission_generic_owner.unified_progress_marker(m.id);
 if private_pending then uf_marker:=jsonb_set(uf_marker,'{batch}','null'::jsonb,false);end if;
 uf_review:=coalesce((uf_marker->>'review_required')::boolean,false);
 if academy and m.stato='in_corso' and r.run_phase='in_corso' then
  select rw.publication_id into flow_publication
  from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
  join public.combat_v2_rounds cr on cr.id=rw.round_id
  join public.combat_v2_sessions cs on cs.id=cr.session_id
  where rw.master_session_id=m.id and rw.publication_id is not null
   and cs.closed_at is null and cs.state='in_corso'
  order by cr.round_no desc,rw.round_id desc limit 1;
  if flow_publication is not null then flow_state:='combat_started';
  else

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.progress_step(p_session uuid, p_user uuid, p_request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;e mission_generic_owner.encounters;
 s public.combat_v2_sessions;roundrow public.combat_v2_rounds;rep public.combat_v2_round_reports;
 sc jsonb;spec jsonb;settings jsonb;term jsonb;cap uuid;actor uuid;res jsonb;n integer;pending jsonb;c7_budget jsonb;c21_owned boolean;
begin
 perform mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
 -- C9: freeze policy DML through proof, Native reserve and authorization.
 LOCK TABLE mission_narrative_internal.runtime_policy IN SHARE MODE;
 perform 1 from public.locations where id=(select location_id from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) for update;
 if p_request is null then raise exception 'MGP_REQUEST_REQUIRED';end if;

 select * into strict m from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session for update;

 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=p_session for update;
 if m.closed_at is not null then return jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-progress/1','master_session_id',p_session,'state','closed','dispatch',null);end if;
 c21_owned:=(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 sticky_wc
 WHERE sticky_wc.master_session_id=p_session AND sticky_wc.scope='staff_mission'

 AND sticky_wc.contract->'features' ? 'execution_authority_v1'

 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation'

 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,release_sha256}'=sticky_wc.release_sha256
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,binding_sha256}'=sticky_wc.definition_sha256) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources ss21
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs21 ON bs21.request_key=ss21.request_key
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.start_claims sc22 ON sc22.session_id=bs21.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.run_bindings rb21 ON rb21.master_session_id=bs21.master_session_id
 JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms21 ON ms21.id=bs21.master_session_id
  AND ms21.mission_id=ss21.carrier_mission_id
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 manual_source WHERE manual_source.master_session_id=bs21.master_session_id) AND bs21.master_session_id=p_session
 AND ms21.owner_kind='ai_service' AND ms21.master_user IS NULL
 AND ms21.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
 AND (ss21.source_mission_id='5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0'::uuid OR (mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(bs21.master_session_id) IS NOT NULL AND ss21.source_mission_id::text=mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(bs21.master_session_id)#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}'))
 AND sc22.state='bound' AND sc22.simulation
 AND sc22.mission_id=ms21.mission_id AND sc22.location_id=ms21.location_id
 AND sc22.request_key=bs21.request_key
 AND bs21.simulation AND bs21.snapshot->'simulation'='true'::jsonb
 AND bs21.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(bs21.snapshot)
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-opening-source/1'
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'mission_id'=ss21.carrier_mission_id::text
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'location_id'='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'
 AND rb21.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(rb21.snapshot)
 AND rb21.snapshot->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-run/1'));

 not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items pending_work where pending_work.master_session_id=p_session
